text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — PR #4821 (refactor/buildkite) is blocked by style nits and a failing Buildkite lint. Need to land before tomorrow's 12:30 UTC merge slot. Can someone take a quick pass? https://git.redwood/PR/4821
Julian: I can look in ~30m. Which checks are failing exactly?
Maya: The failing step is `gofmt` and an import-order lint. From the build log:
```
+ gofmt -l ./...
cmd/service/handler.go
pkg/route/route.go: import order
```
ci-bot: Buildkite pipeline https://buildkite.com/redwood/pr-4821 — linter failing consistently on linux workers (build #243).
Rachel: Probably just `gofumpt` + import grouping. Locally run: `gofmt -w . && gofumpt -w . && ./scripts/sort-imports.sh`. I can open a tiny follow-up patch if you want.
Liam: I can push the fix (import order + tiny var rename).
Julian: @Liam thanks — can you also add a one-line changelog? PM wanted a note about the minor refactor.
Liam: Yep. Pushed branch `fix/4821-style-buildkite-quick` -> https://git.redwood/compare/fix/4821-style-buildkite-quick
Diff snippet:
```
- import ("b", "a")
+ import ("a", "b")
- func Handle(s string) {}
+ func Handle(ctx context.Context, s string) {}
```
Maya: Nice — CI rerunning now.
ci-bot: Re-run scheduled. Build #244 queued.
Rachel: Quick note — try to limit formatting touches to files in this PR to avoid noisy diffs. This looks small and fine.
Julian: Did a quick review, two tiny comments: rename `handler.go:Process` -> `ProcessRequest` for clarity, and add a short doc comment on the exported func. Otherwise LGTM.
Liam: Updated and pushed. Added `// ProcessRequest handles incoming route requests.`
Maya: Can someone approve so I can merge before the window? I'm OOO at 16:00.
Rachel: Approved :+1:
Julian: LGTM, approving now.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy embargo until 15:00 UTC tomorrow. Merge window open 12:00-14:30 UTC. See https://confluence.redwood/deploys
Maya: I'll merge at ~12:30 UTC tomorrow. Thanks for the quick turnaround!
Julian: Great — ping here if post-merge tests flake.
ci-bot: Build #244 passed linter step. All green.
Maya: Perfect, merging tomorrow morning. Thanks all!
